## Styling

Modals support markdown in the body, but you need to leave whitespace between the text and the modal tags. 

```markdown
<Modal title="Title" buttonText='Open Modal'>

**bold** and _italic_ text is supported.

</Modal>
```

## Including Components

```sql orders_by_month
select order_month, sum(sales) as sales_usd0k from needful_things.orders
group by all
```

You can include components inside a Modal, like charts or tables:

```svelte
<Modal title='Chart Example' buttonText='Click to See Chart'>
    <LineChart
        data={orders_by_month}
        x=order_month
        y=sales_usd0k
    />
</Modal>
```

## Options

| Prop | Description | Options | Default |
|------|-------------|---------|---------|
| `buttonText` _(required)_ | The text displayed on the button that triggers the modal. | string |  |
| `title` | The title of the modal. Visible at the top of the modal when it is open | string |  |
| `open` | A boolean value that determines whether the modal is closed by default. | true, false |  |
